definitions.explanation: The count or total of people in a group or at an event.

examples.japanese: {参加|さんか}{人数|にんずう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the number of participants.

examples.japanese: {人数|にんずう}が{多|おお}すぎる。
{人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん}のお{弁当|べんとう}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered lunches for everyone (the number of people).

notes:
COMPOUND: {人|にん} (person) + {数|すう} (number)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {人数|にんずう}を{数|かぞ}える (count the number of people)
- {人数|にんずう}{制限|せいげん} (capacity limit)
- {人数|にんずう}{分|ぶん} (for the number of people)
- {最低|さいてい}{人数|にんずう} (minimum number of people)

PRONUNCIATION NOTE: にんずう is the standard reading. にんず is also sometimes used.

RELATED:
- {定員|ていいん} (capacity, fixed number of people)
- {人員|じんいん} (personnel, staff)
- {人口|じんこう} (population)
